name: legends-geogrid
description: Open-source local SEO geo-grid scans with DataForSEO, cost guardrails, and an interactive map studio.
author: Avalon Reset

scripts.check:python: python -m py_compile tools/local_heatmap_poc.py tools/bulk_geogrid_runner.py tools/geogrid_doctor.py tests/test_runners.py
scripts.dryrun:sample: python tools/bulk_geogrid_runner.py --prospects examples/sample-prospects.csv --run-id sample-dryrun --output-root bulk-runs --method standard --grid-size 5 --radius-km 2 --depth 20 --zoom 15
scripts.check: pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high && pnpm build && pnpm check:python && pnpm test && pnpm doctor && pnpm dryrun:sample
